# `mise plugins update`

- **Usage:** `mise plugins update [-j --jobs <JOBS>] [PLUGIN]…`
- **Aliases:** `up`, `upgrade`
- **Effect:** modifies state
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/plugins/update.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/plugins/update.rs)

Update installed plugins

With no names, updates every installed plugin. This updates the plugin code,
not the tool versions it manages. Linked local plugins are skipped; plugins
installed from an archive cannot be updated with Git.

## Arguments
- **`[PLUGIN]…`** — Plugins to update; append #ref to switch to a branch, tag, or commit

## Flags
- **`-j --jobs <JOBS>`** — Number of plugins to update in parallel (default: the `jobs` setting)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Update every installed plugin

```
mise plugins update
```

Update one plugin

```
mise plugins update my-tool
```

Switch a plugin to its main branch

```
mise plugins update my-tool#main
```
